selected_supplemental_reports.selected_procedure: Bench-fit the OS microSD before carrier insertion and carry it with the module. In-body service only with the panel off, by the dog-leg: straight fine-tip non-conductive tweezers, +X 18 out of the socket, then +Y 40 out of the open panel side. The straight +X path meets the lens collar and the closed-panel path meets the power switch. Tool and finger reach remain a HOLD.
selected_supplemental_reports.scope: Rigid card proxy translations against saved STEPs with the derived obstacle set; no socket-latch, card grasp, tool-body or finger-reach qualification. The front slit (model.py) passes no card path: its closure is user decision VN-29.
